Synopsis:
    Emmitt Smith and business partners are being sued in Delaware Chancery Court by Kituwah LLC (Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians) for allegedly misappropriating a $2.5M loan meant for the "Project Exodus" solar farm in Texas. The suit claims funds were diverted to repay a separate creditor (Wilson Holdings) in a Ponzi-like scheme. Kituwah has received no repayment since the loan came due February 1, 2024. Claims include fraudulent inducement, breach of fiduciary duty, and breach of contract.
